content.comment_body: I am unable to write to the network input coil address using the Modscan tool, although reading coil values is successful. Please review the attached image and advise on possible solutions.

If you are using the latest version of [product_name] (for example, version 8.3): - Did you activate Modbus access in the project’s settings? Go to: File > Properties > Offline Settings > General [IMAGE]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is having trouble configuring Modbus communications to write to network input coil addresses using a third-party client, while reading operations function correctly. The issue seems related to product settings or limitations, and the user is seeking guidance regarding required configuration adjustments.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to both read and write to network input coil addresses via Modbus on their [product_name] module, without needing to perform extensive or complicated setup.
